title: Why You Should Never Correct Claude Twice
description:
If Claude Code fails twice on the same problem, stop. Every failed fix stays in the context, so each new correction is grounded in failure, and that's how you end up three hours deep fixing the fix that fixed the fix. The move is simple: clear the context and rewrite the prompt using what the two failures taught you. 

Get the exact reset workflow here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/18YoGl0UN-3_w5LNE4bjLiCsrtb3N-LG_/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
